joinIntro: On your computer, open Password365 › Devices › Add a device, and scan the code it shows (or paste it). Both must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
unreachable_one: {count} device could not be reached on this network; it syncs next time.
unreachable_other: {count} devices could not be reached on this network; they sync next time.
permLocalNetwork: Password365 syncs your vault directly with your other devices on this network, never through a server.
permCamera: Scan the pairing code shown by Password365 on your computer.
cameraUnavailable: The camera is not available: paste the code instead.
biometryHint: Your master password is still needed every 14 days, after it changes, and when Face ID or Touch ID changes on this phone.
autoLockMobile: Lock after leaving the app for
permFaceID: Unlock Password365 without typing your master password.
autofillNeedsFaceId: Open Password365 and turn on Face ID in Settings to fill from here.
autofillNoMatch: No login for this site yet.
biometryHintAndroid: Your master password is still needed every 14 days, after it changes, and when the fingerprints on this phone change.
autofillNeedsFingerprint: Open Password365 and turn on fingerprint unlock in Settings to fill from here.
autofillServiceHint: Fill usernames, passwords and codes in apps and browsers. In Chrome, also choose Settings › Autofill services › Autofill using another service.
